Week 31 Module Map: Boom, Bust, and the Great Depression

Quarter 4: Convergence and Divergence

The story of boom and bust gives way to a cultural and political one. This is where Texas begins to be absorbed into a more uniform America.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: Boom, Bust, and the Great Depression in Texas
  • Lesson 2: Radio, the New Deal, and the End of Old Texas

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 31 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 31 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 31 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Perseverance and self-government: notice Texans enduring the Depression, and how the New Deal narrowed what the state did for itself.
